The guided code of Lab 02, Part 2 (`prostate`). Data: `data/prostate.csv` (from `faraway::prostate`).

## Split first

```{r split}
library(glmnet)
prostate <- read.csv("data/prostate.csv")
set.seed(2027)
test_id <- sample(nrow(prostate), 30)       # positions in 1:97
train <- prostate[-test_id, ]
test  <- prostate[test_id, ]
stopifnot(length(intersect(rownames(train), rownames(test))) == 0)
```

## Stepwise selection on the training data

```{r step}
full_tr <- lm(lpsa ~ ., data = train)
m_aic <- step(full_tr, trace = 0)
formula(m_aic)
```

## Lasso with fixed folds

```{r lasso, fig.width=9, fig.height=4}
x_tr <- as.matrix(train[, names(train) != "lpsa"])
x_te <- as.matrix(test[, names(test) != "lpsa"])
set.seed(2028)
foldid <- sample(rep(1:10, length.out = nrow(train)))
cv <- cv.glmnet(x_tr, train$lpsa, alpha = 1, foldid = foldid)
c(lambda_min = cv$lambda.min, lambda_1se = cv$lambda.1se)
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(cv)
plot(cv$glmnet.fit, xvar = "lambda", label = TRUE)
```

## Test error, and what leakage does

```{r test}
mse <- function(pred) mean((test$lpsa - pred)^2)
round(c(null      = mse(mean(train$lpsa)),
        ols_full  = mse(predict(full_tr, test)),
        step_aic  = mse(predict(m_aic, test)),
        lasso_min = mse(predict(cv, x_te, s = "lambda.min")),
        lasso_1se = mse(predict(cv, x_te, s = "lambda.1se"))), 3)
x_all <- as.matrix(prostate[, names(prostate) != "lpsa"])
set.seed(2028)
cv_leaky <- cv.glmnet(x_all, prostate$lpsa, alpha = 1,
                      foldid = sample(rep(1:10, length.out = nrow(prostate))))
mse(predict(cv_leaky, x_te, s = "lambda.min"))   # too optimistic: test rows were used
```
